verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-demand agent work: multi-step tasks in a single request, "automate tasks like organizing a folder" by asking the agent, and subagents spawned within a session. Background processing (automatic indexing and an unnamed feature that "works completely in the background") is built-in system behavior, not automations a user sets up. There is no documented scheduling, trigger, or recurring-automation feature, and a scriptable CLI the user could cron is only a building block or workaround, which earns no credit.
